event.odalys_heart2.4.text: Half of Wetherell eats standing up. I'm working through them one patient at a time. You were next.
event.odalys_heart2.4.why: drops the 'only patient' Marcus joke that overheard_marcus_odalys_3 now owns; leaves her want, a village that rests

event.odalys_heart5.0.text: This is my notebook of remedies. Every cure that ever worked in Wetherell, and several that only worked on Marcus.
event.odalys_heart5.0.why: four clinic scenes opened on 'Sit.'; the tic stays in heart 2 and heart 8 only

event.odalys_heart8.after.text: {if choice:office.insist}You insisted I rest. I objected for a full minute. Then I slept nine hours. Elara is unbearable about it.{else}{if choice:office.soup}We finished the pot. I've written it up: 'Treatment successful. Repeat weekly.' That last part was not a question.{else}Your prescription is pinned above my desk. 'Come back anyway.' I intend to comply. Doctor's orders.{/if}{/if}
event.odalys_heart8.after.why: insist branch no longer repeats the birthday's 'filed under' joke

dlg.odalys.office.r0.text: You insist. ...Accepted. Under protest, with soup, and in front of a witness.
dlg.odalys.office.r0.why: 'Very well' was used in three scenes

event.odalys_birthday.intro.text: It's my birthday. I observe it with soup. That is an invitation, not an order. Mostly.
event.odalys_birthday.intro.why: varies the 'Sit.' opener across clinic scenes

dlg.odalys.birthday.r2.text: A nap, prescribed by a farmer. ...Very well. My patients will be told it was an emergency.
dlg.odalys.birthday.r2.why: 'I'll comply' is saved for the heart 8 payoff

event.odalys_birthday.after.text: {if choice:bday.odalys.wish}It went in the file labeled 'Unexpected'. That file was empty last winter. It isn't now.{else}{if choice:bday.odalys.soup}Shared soup. Elara says I smiled twice. She's counting, and she's wrong. It was three.{else}I napped twenty minutes. The clinic survived. Elara says nothing happened. She said it very quickly.{/if}{/if}
event.odalys_birthday.after.why: soup branch no longer duplicates heart 8's written-up 'successful' joke

event.overheard_elara_odalys_2.l2.text: I accept the soup. I need to know the surprise first. Professionally.
event.overheard_elara_odalys_2.l2.why: three Elara scenes in a row opened on 'Elara.'

event.overheard_elara_odalys_3.l2.text: It's very soft, Elara. ...Ten minutes after lunch. Do not mistake that for a habit.

event.overheard_elara_odalys_3.l4.text: Good care. Wake me for emergencies only. Splinters are not emergencies.
event.overheard_elara_odalys_3.l4.why: her name was already in l2

event.overheard_odalys_ione_1.l3.text: Patients keep odd hours. Books do not. ...Agreed. Call it a draw.

event.overheard_odalys_ione_2.l1.text: Ione. I prescribe you a nap. Fifteen minutes. I've already written it down.
event.overheard_odalys_ione_2.l1.why: Elara's scene already has the ten-minute nap

event.overheard_odalys_ione_3.l3.text: If Hazel reorganized nothing, it's a verified remedy. Pass the cup.
event.overheard_odalys_ione_3.l3.why: 'the stove' answered nothing; now answers Ione's Hazel line

event.overheard_marcus_odalys_1.l3.text: Measure twice, bend the knees once. That one isn't carpentry. It's mine.
event.overheard_marcus_odalys_1.l3.why: 'Doctor's orders' was in three scenes; kept for heart 2 and heart 8

threads.odalys_heart2: Who else in Wetherell is she working through, and does she ever put herself on the list?
threads.odalys_heart5: Edmund has a page in her notebook, and he put his affairs in order: what was on it?
threads.odalys_heart8: Will she really keep the weekly appointment she has just prescribed herself?
threads.odalys_birthday: The 'Unexpected' file, or Elara's count, or the nap: Dr. Penn is learning to rest, slowly.
threads.overheard_elara_odalys_1: The stool has a cozy; how far will Elara push clinic policy?
threads.overheard_elara_odalys_2: Elara's next disguised vegetable, and the bowl saved for later.
threads.overheard_elara_odalys_3: Will the ten-minute nap become the habit she says it is not?
threads.overheard_marcus_odalys_2: The bench outside the clinic, and whether Elara finds out she sat on it.
threads.overheard_marcus_odalys_3: Marcus is building her a chair for Saturdays.

notes: odalys_heart8 still plays 9-17 while the bible calls it a 'rare quiet evening'; the intro says she closed early today. Director: move the trigger to evening or keep as is.
